name: Štajerska Slovenija

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this cool ripen Riesling, Chardonnay, Müller-Thurgau, Pinot Gris and Gewürztraminer fully without cooking off their freshness.
Chardonnay and Riesling sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Sauvignon Blanc is at its cool limit. In cool years it can stay underripe, with green, sharp flavors.

soil.rock: Clay holds water well but drains poorly. It stays cool, which slows ripening and keeps acidity up.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: The high ground runs about 5°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.
Much of it is steep. Cold air and rain run off, so frost and waterlogging are rare and soils stay thin, keeping yields low. Steep rows are slow and costly to work, often by hand.

winkler: Only very early grapes ripen well, mostly hybrids and a few vinifera.
